values.note: 10 sites including a host site; 3 pull-throughs; gravel roads and parking spurs. No length published by the Forest Service.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/howard-lake-campground ('10 sites (3 pull throughs) including one host site'; 'Campground roads and parking spurs are gravel.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Forest Service campground at Howard Lake south of Libby on road 4779, ~4,100 ft. Gravel spurs; a swimming beach with two day-use sites; fishing and motorized boating on the lake. The camp host may close the gate 10 pm-7 am. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Feb 27, 2026): confirmed $10, 10 sites with 3 pull-throughs, vault toilets, no potable water; added season May 1 - Nov 30 (gate dates; managed Memorial Day-Labor Day), 16-day limit, and the page's own 50% Senior/Access discount. Reservations not mentioned (inherited federal booking left). No length published.
flags: Rig length: the Forest Service page gives no length, but Visit Montana's listing (https://visitmt.com/listing/howard-lake-campground-2185, apparently older FS text) says 'The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 20 feet.' No reviewer rig of 23 ft+ found. Possible criteria problem (under 23 ft); not written to max_rig_ft.

Access-road flag: Kootenai alert 'Kootenai Flood Event & Inaccessible Areas' (start Dec 16, 2025, no end date) lists washouts on NFS Road 231 Libby Creek Road at mileposts 0.9 and 8.1 (and on its West Fisher end at 19.3 and 25.5); Howard Lake is reached from that road via 4779. Check before going.
Visit Montana lists potable water and a 14-day limit; the Forest Service page says no potable water and a 16-day limit (recorded the Forest Service values).
